thread.title: Netflix shares fall 3% premarket as FAANG, media stocks follow broader market down - MarketWatch

author: Trey Williams
title: Netflix shares fall 3% premarket as FAANG, media stocks follow broader market down - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Netflix Inc. NFLX, -4.92% were down as much as 3% in premarket trade on Tuesday after dropping roughly 5% on Monday as the broader market continues to sell off . Netflix shares are now down more than 11% from its Jan. 29 intraday high. Other stocks in the FAANG category continued their downward trend in premarket on Tuesday as broader market sank. Facebook Inc. FB, -4.74% and Amazon.com Inc. were down more than 1%, Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.50% was down a little less than 1% and Alphabet Inc. (formerly Google) GOOGL, -5.08% was down 2%. Some of Netflix's cohorts in the media sector were also struggling in premarket trade. Walt Disney Co. DIA, -4.57% shares were down more than 2%, while shares of Viacom Inc.'s commonly-owned class B shares were down roughly 4% and shares of Discovery Communications Inc. DISCA, -4.33% were down more than 3%.
